Community Engineer (multiple roles and seniority levels)

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Community Engineer (multiple roles and seniority levels) role at Canonical

Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence when it comes to serving the open source ecosystem. This is your chance to be a part of that as a Community Engineer at Canonical .
We are building community management at scale. We have multiple positions available, at different seniority levels.
All applications and candidates are handled through this single entry point.
The role of a Community Engineer
The Community team at Canonical enables community leaders and participants to get things done, co-ordinating with Canonical teams and ensuring that community processes are efficient and well run. We don't do the work of the community, but we facilitate that work to ensure that energetic and ambitious community members with their own vision of open source can benefit from the work Canonical does and bring their own flavor of Ubuntu into being, to meet the needs and express the interests of their community. You will play a key role in designing, executing, and scaling initiatives that foster a thriving community.
This is an exciting opportunity for a technically proficient person who is passionate about open source software, Linux, and sustainable community building.
In this role, you will support community initiatives with your technical skills and strong organizational skills. You work hand in hand with developers to smooth processes and integrate community plans with Canonical plans for maximum impact. You can encourage and facilitate the creation of new technical projects that enhance the community contribution experience, and you represent community interests to Canonical teams. You will lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from conception through launch, working closely with Developer Relations engineers, technical authors, product managers, marketing teams, engineering teams, and external partners.
You will support and engage with volunteer developers in the Ubuntu community, addressing their concerns and helping them to create successful tools. You will help to ensure their success and the overall autonomy and sustainability of projects.
You will provide the content and technical support to ensure the community stays engaged and informed. This will include regular blog and social media posts about community initiatives, events, accomplishments, and collaborative efforts between Canonical and the Ubuntu community.
You will communicate effectively with developers and software engineers and represent not only the Ubuntu community but Canonical as a contributor to the wider Linux ecosystem. Our team attends conferences and expos, and talks about technical community projects and their development processes.
Location : These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
What your day will look like

  • Write high quality content to promote and support community initiatives
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions to community problems
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Potential opportunity to travel more if you wish
  • Nurture community contributions to Ubuntu
  • Engage with the Ubuntu community through Discourse, Matrix, social media, conferences, etc.
  • Represent Ubuntu via speaking engagements at events and conferences
  • Support the engagement by Canonical teams into the open source ecosystem
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have experience with developer tools and open source projects
  • You have a clear public record of accomplishments (talks, blog posts, GitHub, X, etc.)
  • You have interest and experience with some of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, DevOps, software development, testing and QA, package management, container technology
  • You can work autonomously and assume full ownership of objectives as needed
  • You can be flexible with your time and enjoy working with new technology in a fast-paced environment
  • You are experienced working with open source communities and understand the workflow of volunteer contributors
  • You have experience in (technical) program management and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with community management
  • Experience with Developer advocacy
  • Experience as a software developer
  • Examples of contributions to the Ubuntu Community
  • Experience with contributing to open source projects
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Job Description Summary

The turbine lead Engineer should be the technical person responsible for turbine mechanical design coordination in a project execution . He will be responsible to give ll all the need technical support not only to the engineering team but also to the other cross functional areas.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Be the technical person in charge of hydro turbine mechanical design on a new or refurbishment project, supported by Principal/Consulting Engineers.
  • Analyze technical information from Work Packages (Technical Specifications, Division of Work) and participate in identifying the risks and opportunities of the project on technical matters.
  • Plan and follow project engineering basic design phase and coordinate with Hydraulic design team (hydraulic test lab) and Special Calculation team.
  • Perform designs and calculations of turbine components and validate critical ones with Principal/Consulting Engineers.
  • Direct and manage design reviews, perform design review actions follow-up.
  • Provide technical support to the customer in coordination with the project System Integrator.
  • Prepare information for the execution of technical drawings and supervise and validate the draftsman work.
  • Optimize designs with Supply Chain, Site Installation to get the lowest installed equipment costs.
  • Write reports and engineering documents, including test procedures, engineering calculation notes, operation and maintenance manuals.
  • Occasionally conduct site visits to assess the existing turbine and participate to signature tests on the unit before disassembly at site.
  • Provide technical support to Supply Chain and to Site Installation team (erection and commissioning) of sub-assemblies / components under your responsibility.
  • Follow up the performance testing of the prototype turbine on site.
  • Develop tools and design guides for turbine engineering.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering including a minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in mechanical design.
  • Experience with NX, AutoCad and/or SolidWorks .
  • Demonstrate technical leadership.
  • Ability to work in a team and communicate effectively.
  • Must be willing to comply with pre-employment screening, including but not limited, reference verification and background check.
  • Availability for occasional travel, in Brazil, Canada and USA.
  • Willingness to develop in-depth knowledge of hydro technical discipline using prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English (French is a plus).
  • Interact fluidly with colleagues in our other facilities across and/or outside Brazil, and who are generally unable to communicate in Portuguese and whose language at work is predominantly English.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Ability to influence others and lead small teams.
  • Ability to coordinate several mandates simultaneously.
  • Effective problem identification and solution skills.
  • Proven analytical and organizational ability.

  • Ensure that content is culturally relevant and aligns with strategic and brand guidelines.
  • Ensure proper usage of NBA brand assets and maintain content standards across all platforms.

  • Must be knowledgeable about the NBA, players & teams, and how content can be localized for respective markets
  • Willingness to explore new ways to create & publish content to grow the NBA’s local audience.
  • Proven experience managing production companies and third-party vendors.
  • Deep understanding of production workflows, post-production, technical specs, and deliverables.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and communication skills.
  • Must have strong writing, communication skills, as well as the ability to execute editorial judgment
  • Ability to work on a deadline and handle multiple tasks
  • Flexibility in work schedule is required (i.e nights & weekends)

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno
description:
Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno

Posição: Analista em Planejamento Financeiro Pleno

Programa/Departamento: Operações / Planejamento Financeiro

O WRI Brasil está em busca de um profissional para atuar como Analista em Planejamento Financeiro que atuará no suporte às atividades da área e relacionamento com as demais áreas e equipes internas.

Principais atividades e/ou responsabilidades

  • Gestão Financeira de Projetos: Monitorar o fluxo de caixa e validar relatórios financeiros, assegurando que estejam em conformidade com as diretrizes dos doadores e da organização.
  • Análises Financeiras: Realizar análises detalhadas da performance orçamentária, identificando desvios entre o planejado e o realizado, além de tendências e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Controle de Despesas: Acompanhar as despesas organizacionais, garantindo sua correta classificação contábil e contribuindo para a consolidação e apresentação dos resultados no fechamento financeiro mensal.
  • Atualização de Dados: Manter atualizadas as informações financeiras nos sistemas internos da organização.
  • Previsões e Projeções: Contribuir para a elaboração de projeções financeiras de curto e longo prazo, alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos e ao desempenho histórico da organização.
  • Auditoria de Projetos: Preparar relatórios financeiros e documentos de apoio para auditorias de projetos, conforme os requisitos estabelecidos.
  • Relacionamento com Parceiros: Atuar como ponto focal para esclarecimentos financeiros junto a parceiros internos.
  • Melhoria de Processos: Identificar e propor aprimoramentos em processos, ferramentas e práticas de planejamento financeiro, com foco em eficiência, controle e qualidade das informações.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Graduação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em análise financeira, elaboração de orçamentos, avaliação de riscos e interpretação de dados financeiros;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos em Planejamento e controle financeiro; Gestão de projetos e compreensão de conceitos contábeis; Processos de orçamentação e análise de desempenho;
  • Excel avançado (incluindo fórmulas, gráficos, dashboards e tabelas dinâmicas);
  • Desejável: conhecimento em Power BI e sistemas ERP (como SAP, Workday, Oracle ou similares).
  • Competências Comportamentais: Perfil analítico, atenção a detalhes, senso crítico e questionador. Proatividade, boa comunicação, dinamismo, atitude “mão na massa” (hands-on), resiliência, foco em resolução de problemas e capacidade de gestão de prazos e prioridades;
  • Inglês em nível intermediário (leitura de documentos, comunicação básica escrita e verbal).

Como se inscrever

Caso você se qualifique para a vaga, inscreva-se online no site até dia 20 de julho de 2025. Só serão consideradas no processo de seleção inscrições submetidas por este site.

Promoção da Diversidade

O WRI Brasil busca incorporar a diversidade em suas ações e projetos. Por isso, se desejar, indique na sua Carta de Intenções informações que julgar relevantes para consideração em sua candidatura, incluindo, mas não se limitando a: raça/etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, origem regional, vínculo com populações tradicionais, deficiência física ou necessidade específica.

Sobre o WRI Brasil

O WRI Brasil é um instituto de pesquisa que trabalha em parceria para gerar transformação. Atua no desenvolvimento de estudos e implementação de soluções para que as pessoas tenham o essencial para viver, para proteger e restaurar a natureza, pelo equilíbrio do clima e por comunidades resilientes. Alia excelência técnica à articulação política e trabalha com governos, empresas, academia e sociedade civil.

O WRI Brasil faz parte do World Resources Institute (WRI). Fundado em 1982, o WRI conta com cerca de 1,7 mil profissionais pelo mundo, com escritórios em Brasil, China, Colômbia, Índia, Indonésia, México e Estados Unidos, além de escritórios regionais na África e na Europa.

title: Operador(a) de Logística
description:
O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência em recebimento, conferência, separação e movimentação de mercadorias.
  • Experiência no sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.
  • Desejável habilidade na administração de prioridades.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado, prática e permanente respeito aos procedimentos, normas e regras da empresa.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana e feriados.
  • Orientação para a satisfação do cliente.

Como é o dia a dia de um(a) Operador(a) de Logística:

  • RECEPÇÃO DE MERCADORIAS:
    • Realiza a recepção quantitativa e qualitativa das mercadorias comercializadas e não comercializadas (equipamentos, materiais de escritório, etc), verificando e identificando o estado geral, fornecedor, metragem, referência, tonalidade, prazo de validade, etc.
    • Prepara o espaço físico e equipamentos necessários para a correta recepção, evitando a perda de produtividade na conferência.
    • Anota sobre o relatório de conferência tudo o que for relativo às mercadorias recebidas (quantidades, estado aparente, validades, etc), assegurando qualidade e prevenindo perdas.
    • Armazena as mercadorias no endereço de depósito correto, através da leitura da ficha da recepção buscando agilizar as futuras montagens dos pedidos de retira ou de entrega.
    • Etiqueta os produtos com código de barra ausente ou defeituoso e inserir as etiquetas de segurança nos produtos sensíveis a furtos, assegurando que as mercadorias entregues ao comércio estejam disponíveis para venda.
    • Separa as mercadorias seguindo a tipologia dos fluxos quanto a mercadorias de loja ou do depósito.
    • Libera as mercadorias para a armazenagem na Loja ou no Depósito, contatando a equipe de Reposição ou a de Armazenamento para efetuar a armazenagem (Cautela).
    • Realiza ações anti-demarcas através da checagem qualitativa e quantitativa rigorosa sobre as mercadorias recepcionadas, através de um bom fluxo de veículos no pátio da Recepção de Mercadorias e do correto manuseio dos equipamentos de movimentação (paleteiras, "gaiolas", etc).
    • Mantém organizado os equipamentos, ferramentas de trabalho e EPI’s (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual).
    • Realiza o empilhamento seguro dos paletes evitando prejuízos à bens e pessoas.
    • Mantém a área de recepção limpa e organizada ajudando a combater a demarca e prevenindo acidentes no trabalho.
    • Recebe as demarcas validadas pelo Comércio realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e colocando o produto demarcado no local de despejo.
    • Recebe as devoluções aos fornecedores, validadas pelo Comércio, realizando as conferências quali-quantitativas e agendando a coleta.
    • Recebe as remessas para Assistência Técnica, realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e agendando a coleta.
  • RETIRADA E ENTREGA EM DOMICÍLIO:
    • Efetua a separação do RSS (reserva sobre estoque), identificando os produtos e informando a separação para o setor comercial.
    • Realiza o endereçamento das mercadorias fazendo a reserva física de espaço e inventário rotativo com base na listagem dos produtos de RSS.
    • Efetua a entrega das mercadorias ao cliente, de forma ágil e cordial, colocando-as no veículo do cliente.
    • Separa e confere as mercadorias verificando todos os itens descritos no pedido emitido, disponibilizando-as para entrega a clientes no setor de retirada de mercadorias ou para transportadora (entrega em domicilio).
  • REPOSIÇÃO:
    • Repõe os produtos na loja de forma adequada.
  • GESTÃO DO ESTOQUE:
    • Armazena e garante a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos estoques.
    • Verifica diariamente os pedidos gerados pela área comercial, analisa a consistência de dados necessários no pedido (endereços, telefones, data entrega, referência, disponibilidade, etc), organizando a separação cronológica dos pedidos e liberando-os para faturamento.
    • Efetua atendimento telefônico informando os clientes sobre prazos de entrega.
    • Informa o Supervisor de Logística sobre eventuais problemas que envolvem a equipe de separação, operação e produtos.
    • Auxilia o Supervisor de Logística para o bom andamento dos endereçamentos do depósito (set-up, inventários rotativos, etc).

Recruitment, Enablement, Development

  • Indirect-only territories: Sells through partner organizations to end users in coordination with partner sales resources.
  • VARs: Enable partner organizations to handle unassisted sales to end users
  • Build a strong partner pipeline through co-marketing programs, account and field mapping of company and partner sellers

General Partner Management

  • Manages potential channel conflict with other firm sales channels by fostering excellent communication internally and externally, and through strict adherence to channel rules of engagement.
  • Ensures partner compliance with partner agreements.
  • Drives adoption of company programs among assigned partners
  • Monitors performance of partners and coaches them to higher levels of success.
  • Assist the overall business development team in developing good PRM systems, efficient partner workflows, company and partner performance reporting, partner marketing and support activities to enhance the partner program.

  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience in a similar role with a strong focus on indirect sales and channel development for a software company.
  • Track record of results-oriented sales and partner management that sets and achieves metrics for partner recruiting, enablement, opportunity generation, revenue.
  • Excellent knowledge and experience of the workings of reseller, systems integrator and consulting ecosystem. Past relationships and network is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to interact with technical and business counterparts both within and outside the company.
  • Professional sales training would be an advantage but not essential.

title: Reservoir Engineer
description:
The position involves supporting all reservoir engineering activities, including oil and gas reserve estimation, production forecasting, reservoir simulation, and production optimization, while also demonstrating an understanding of geoscience concepts, drilling, completions, and production operations.

• Expert in integrated reservoir simulation studies, including data analysis and integration, model construction, history matching, calibration and predictions.

• Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both NPV and hydrocarbon recovery.

• Competent in the analysis of capillary pressure, relative permeability and PVT data.

• Competent in compositional reservoir modeling.

• Participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.

• Evaluates and initiates exploitation opportunities, including new drilling and work-overs to maximize reserves recovery and booking, and overall play economics.

• Prepare data and perform PTA interpretation and modeling.

• Formulate the strategies for reservoir development, data acquisition, field surveillance and monitor masterplans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.

• Extensive working knowledge of standard vendor applications for pre and post-processing of simulation data and Assisted History Matching software and workflows.

• Is familiar with field production activities to effectively implement reservoir management aspects during the field production phase, including liaison with regulatory agencies.

• Develop Life of Field production profiles and maintain auditable booked reserves estimates and reserves reports

• Coordinate and integrate data, simulation and studies between Artificial lift, production, and dynamic modeling to support the other areas.

• Work with the Production Engineer/Technologist to optimize well potentials.

• Write concise reports for all studies and maintain comprehensive, accessible and up-to-date records of input and interpreted data.

• Coordinates with the business development on acquisition and divestiture projects. Supports the reservoir engineering evaluation component of company acquisition


Education

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Petroleum Engineering.

• Long relevant experience may compensate for formal education

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience with reservoir engineering within the oil and gas industry.

• Reservoir engineering, reservoir management and reservoir simulation skills are essential.

• Proven track record in performing reservoir modeling and field development studies.

• Pressure transient analysis (PTA) interpretation experience will be a plus.
Knowledge

• High proficiency in any reservoir simulation software (Eclipse or T-Nav preferred)

• Proficiency in any production software like Pipesim and/or Prosper.

• Experience with any pressure transient analysis software like Kappa or Pansystem.

description:
Você é apaixonado(a) por excelência no atendimento ao cliente e tem olhar afiado para riscos e segurança? Quer liderar uma equipe que protege a jornada do cliente enquanto entrega valor e confiança? Então essa vaga é para você!


About Experian


A Serasa Experian é a primeira e a maior Datatech do Brasil. Líder em soluções de inteligência para análise de riscos e oportunidades, com foco nas jornadas de crédito, autenticação e prevenção à fraude. Com tecnologia de ponta, inovação e os melhores talentos, transforma a incerteza do risco na melhor decisão, ajudando pessoas a realizarem seus sonhos e empresas de todos os portes e segmentos a prosperarem.

Temos 22.000 pessoas operando em 32 países e a cada dia estamos investindo em novas tecnologias, profissionais talentosos e inovação para ajudar todos os clientes a maximizarem cada oportunidade. Com sede corporativa em Dublin, Irlanda, a Experian está listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN) e compõe o índice FTSE 100.


Experience and Skills


O que buscamos em você:

  • Vivência prévia com áreas relacionadas a experiência do cliente (Customer Success / Customer Experience);
  • Imprescindívelexperiência no segmento de prevenção a fraudes, incluindo pelo menos uma posição de liderança com impacto estratégico e financeiro comprovado;
  • Histórico de sucesso na gestão de carteiras de clientes estratégicos;
  • Domínio e experiência no ecossistema de prevenção a fraudes em diferentes segmentos de mercado e áreas de negócio (financeiro, indústria, varejo, outros);
  • Conhecimento sólido de soluções antifraude (ex.: biometria comportamental, machine learning, score de risco, validação de identidade, autenticação multifator, etc);
  • Familiaridade com integrações técnicas (APIs, webhooks), jornadas de onboarding e KPIs críticos para mitigação de risco;
  • Capacidade de analisar indicadores de churn, NPS, engajamento de clientes e adoção de funcionalidades;
  • Forte habilidade em traduzir insights de dados em planos de ação orientados a retenção e expansão de receita;
  • Proficiência em Análise de Dados (Habilidade em trabalhar com dados, incluindo extração e manipulação, capacidade de criar relatórios e dashboards utilizando ferramentas para apresentar insights de maneira clara, reuniões executivas com os Clientes);
  • Fornecer orientações estratégicas que ajudem o cliente a atingir seus objetivos de longo prazo; Inglês avançado será considerado diferencial.

Quais serão às suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar relacionamento com clientes de médio e grande porte (estabelecer e manter um relacionamento sólido com clientes, garantindo que suas necessidades e expectativas sejam atendidas de forma ágil e eficaz);
  • Garantir a ativação das soluções de prevenção a fraudes e o Onboarding dos clientes (Auxiliar na implementação de soluções do ecossistema de prevenção a fraudes, garantindo a integração e o uso eficaz das soluções fornecidas pela Serasa, treinar e capacitar os clientes na utilização das plataformas e softwares de análise de crédito);
  • Engajar os clientes na adoção e consumo das soluções por meio do acompanhamento de Performance (Monitorar o consumo e performance, analisando métricas e KPIs relevantes para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e crescimento, upgrade de produtos);
  • Garantir a retenção de clientes, acelerar o consumo e upssell de capacidades e identificar oportunidades de cross-sell, (monitorar risco de churn, Identificar e mapear oportunidades de cross-sell e up-sell, promovendo o consumo de mais dados e serviços para impulsionar a receita, promover workshops com clientes para discussão e demonstração das soluções Serasa e como podemos apoiá-los em seus desafios de negócio);
  • Gestão de Crises e Solução de Problemas (Propor melhorias nos processos e nas soluções oferecidas, com base no feedback dos clientes e nas tendências do mercado);
  • Liderança de time e Estratégia do Negócio (Visão consultiva e atualizações de portifólio);
  • Viver a missão: Representar ativamente a voz do cliente na companhia, garantindo excelência em toda a sua jornada - do onboarding ao uso avançado das soluções - impulsionando a retenção, expansão e promoção ativa da marca pelos clientes. Atuamos estrategicamente para gerar valor contínuo, maximizar a satisfação, e acelerar o crescimento sustentável do negócio.

Additional Information


Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. Por isso, contamos com diversas ações para promover um recrutamento inclusivo e apoiar no desenvolvimento profissional das nossas pessoas. Além disso, temos os nossos grupos de afinidade, criados para empoderar e acolher as pessoas de grupos sub-representados:

ExperianPride (comunidade LGBTQIAPN+), Ubuntu (equidade racial), Women in Experian (equidade de gênero) e aspire (pessoas com deficiência) e Connecting Generations (gerações).

Venha fazer parte dessa transformação!

title: Software Engineering Manager - Vaga Afirmativa para Mulheres
description:
Descrição da empresa

Como é o dia a dia de #Cropwiser?

Nenhum dia é igual ao outro e a gente ama esse dinamismo. Aliamos um ambiente de startup com forte liberdade e autonomia com a solidez de uma empresa global líder de mercado. Por isso, se você quer protagonizar a evolução do agro, trabalhar em um time de alta performance e viver um ambiente que valoriza inovação e novas ideias, chega mais! Estávamos à sua espera.

️ E o desafio de ser Engineering Manager?

O Protector é um dos nossos produtos digitais, essencial para potencializar o manejo integrado de pragas e a agricultura de precisão.

Como Engineering Manager, você será uma peça fundamental na construção, liderança e desenvolvimento de um time de engenharia de alta performance, focado em sistemas complexos e escaláveis . Mais do que garantir entregas de qualidade, você terá um papel ativo na definição da visão técnica e estratégica , atuando diretamente na evolução da nossa arquitetura e na padronização de engenharia . Queremos líderes que promovam as melhores práticas e impulsionem o crescimento contínuo do time. Você atuará tanto no desenvolvimento de software quanto na gestão de pessoas , garantindo que cada pessoa da equipe cresça em um ambiente desafiador e alinhado às suas aspirações de carreira e aos objetivos de negócio.

O que significa uma vaga afirmativa?

Vagas afirmativas são oportunidades exclusivas destinadas a aumentar a representatividade em nosso time de tecnologia. Estas vagas visam garantir a diversidade de talentos, ideias e experiências, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho mais inclusivo e acolhedor. Na Syngenta Digital, acreditamos que a diversidade é um ativo fundamental para impulsionar a inovação e o crescimento sustentável.

Atividades principais:

  • Construir e liderar times de engenharia de software de alta performance, promovendo um ambiente de colaboração, inovação contínua e ownership distribuído;
  • Contribuir ativamente no desenvolvimento e deploy de código, estabelecendo um alto padrão técnico e fomentando um senso de arquitetura compartilhada em um contexto de sistemas distribuídos e complexos;
  • Definir, promover e garantir boas práticas de engenharia de software, desde o design arquitetural e escalabilidade até a performance e a observabilidade;
  • Interagir proativamente com stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões técnicas estejam alinhadas à estratégia de produto e às necessidades de negócio, priorizando a clareza e o pragmatismo em vez da burocracia excessiva;
  • Gerenciar riscos, métricas, qualidade e eficiência operacional do time, utilizando dados e indicadores para direcionar decisões e otimizar a performance;
  • Fomentar o crescimento e a evolução dos(as) engenheiros(as), promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo, desenvolvimento técnico e planejamento de carreira;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança na engenharia, propondo melhorias de processos, tecnologias e estratégias que otimizem a capacidade de redução de complexidade de software legado e evitem reinvenções desnecessárias;
  • Manter disciplina e transparência em relação a orçamento, alocação de recursos e prioridades estratégicas.

Qualificações necessárias:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos como desenvolvedor(a) sênior e 3 anos como líder técnico ou gerente de engenharia em times com 5 ou mais pessoas, preferencialmente em sistemas de grande escala ou complexidade;
  • Forte background em engenharia de software, com sólida experiência em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos, design patterns e boas práticas de desenvolvimento que promovam clareza e escalabilidade;
  • Experiência comprovada com AWS ou outras plataformas de nuvem, demonstrando habilidade em construir e operar infraestrutura resiliente;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, com habilidade para traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos, garantir alinhamento entre time e stakeholders, e influenciar decisões estratégicas;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente é obrigatório, capacitando o trabalho em um ambiente global e com acesso a referências internacionais;
  • Atitude de dono(a), sempre em busca de evolução, inovação e excelência técnica, com foco em impacto e resultados tangíveis.

    Benefícios adicionais:

    • Plano de Saúde com cobertura nacional — sem custo para você ou dependentes;
    • Plano Odontológico;
    • Conexa Saúde: acompanhamento psicológico e nutricional;
    • Wellhub (Gympass): para movimentar-se do seu jeito;
    • EAP (Programa de Assistência ao Empregado): suporte psicológico, jurídico e financeiro;
    • Auxílio-creche;
    • Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida;
    • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no iFood Card;
    • Benefício flexível extra via iFood Card;
    • Vidalink: 50% de subsídio em medicamentos com receita;
    • Acesso a plataformas de desenvolvimento pessoal e técnico;
    • Aulas de inglês;
    • Seguro de vida;
    • Parceria com o SESC-MG;
    • Horário flexível e benefício para trabalho remoto.

title: Supervisor de Coleta
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Se o seu propósito é inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas, você está no lugar certo!

A Sabin, fundada em 1984 em Brasília (DF), é reconhecida por seus valores e princípios que colocam as pessoas no centro de sua estratégia. Com uma cultura organizacional forte, promovemos respeito, desenvolvimento, diversidade e inclusão, sendo uma das Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no Brasil e na América Latina há mais de 17 anos.

Desde 2010, expandimos nossa presença para 78 cidades em 15 estados e no Distrito Federal, realizando mais de 42 milhões de exames por ano e atendendo a mais de 6,5 milhões de clientes.

Nosso propósito de inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas guia uma equipe de 7.000 colaboradores dedicada a oferecer serviços de saúde de excelência em todo o país.

Nosso portfólio inclui mais de 7,5 mil exames laboratoriais e de imagem, além de serviços de vacinas com mais de 20 tipos de imunizações, o serviço de check-up executivo Sabin Prime, e a plataforma digital Rita Saúde. Contamos também com áreas de atenção primária à saúde, por meio da Amparo Saúde, e soluções de prontuário eletrônico.

Para mais informações, acesse ou nossas redes sociais: LinkedIn: Sabin Medicina Diagnóstica, Instagram: @sabinmedicinadiagnostica, Facebook: Sabin Medicina Diagnóstica.

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Noções de Biossegurança;
  • Conhecimentos na rotina do setor de atuação;
  • Normas regulamentadas da sua área de atuação;

Horário de trabalho: 44 horas semanais.

Processo Seletivo

  1. Apresentação do Case
  2. Entrevista Individual com Coordenação e Gestão Regional

A Sabin é referência em saúde, destaque em gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, atuando com práticas sustentáveis e presença comunitária. Fundada por Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, a empresa possui cerca de 7.000 colaboradores e está presente em 14 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 354 unidades.

Nosso ecossistema de saúde integra análises clínicas, diagnósticos por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunizações e check-ups executivos, além de serviços de atenção primária e a plataforma Rita Saúde, promovendo acesso à saúde de qualidade em todo o Brasil.

Em 2020, lançamos o SkyHub.Bio, um hub de inovação para startups no setor de saúde, e mantemos o Instituto Sabin, que desde 2005 realiza ações de impacto social, beneficiando mais de 1,6 milhão de pessoas e 902 organizações.

Fique atento aos nossos processos seletivos e evite golpes: não cobramos valores em qualquer etapa do processo.

title: Médico Geriatra Brasilia DF - Banco de talentos
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve refletir a individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo autonomia e qualidade de vida aos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Medicina com Residência em Geriatria, Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, refletido em nossa equipe composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajudar a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento psiquiátrico de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Fortalecer a confiança no atendimento remoto, assegurando que cada consulta seja conduzida com o mesmo rigor e acolhimento de um atendimento presencial.

title: Workplace Experience Partner
description:
As Workplace Experience Partner ll you will keep the São Paulo Publishing Office and eSports Arena rolling and cultivate a space where all Rioters can thrive. You will be responsible for assisting the Americas Region Workplace Experience Manager in all aspects of local operations management and program management within the scope of workplace experience as well as being the primary point of contact for the São Paulo Publishing Office and eSports Arena.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the overall inner-workings of the Riot office and arena. Partner with stakeholders such as local Riot leadership, building management, WE team, and Physical Security to develop and enact programs that maximize workplace effectiveness. Ensure the established budget is maintained and work to hold vendors accountable within budgetary constraints.
  • Manage local vendor and/or supplier relationships to ensure WE contractors perform day-to-day responsibilities and continue to meet Riot standards. Coordinate with on-site physical security as needed.
  • Monitor for and oversee maintenance and repairs, closely aligning with local and WE leadership. Monitor and improve office and arena environments to adhere to WE standards.
  • Partner with local leadership to drive effective Workplace Experience programs and provide insight on workplace needs.
  • Welcome visitors and out-of-town Rioters to the office. Allocate and log visitor passes to the office and help out-of-town Rioters with temporary badge access. Support creation of any workplace experience-related processes for the eSports arena.
  • Support space planning and workplace moves by collaborating with Rioters to understand their needs and executing necessary changes. Ensure the workspace is optimized to enable teams to operate effectively and deliver high value to our players.
  • Perform environmental health and safety (EHS) compliance activities and maintain and optimize office procedure documentation.
  • Support local office events and large-scale initiatives, including esports tournaments and cultural celebrations that reflect Brazilian holidays and traditions. Responsibilities include event planning, communications, vendor coordination, and on-site support to drive employee engagement and a strong sense of belonging.
  • Support regional operations, including recruiting coordination, employer branding and marketing initiatives, and managing travel logistics for local Rioters. This includes handling travel arrangements and collaborating with travel agencies to ensure smooth and cost-effective travel experiences.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience of providing facilities or maintenance service in a busy organization.
  • Experience managing contractors and suppliers, including monitoring service standards and ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures. Strong negotiation skills are essential for vendor management and contract discussions.
  • Comprehensive understanding of Brazilian labor law (CLT), particularly in adapting workplace practices to remain compliant.
  • Events management expertise with the ability to deliver high-quality, compliant experiences.
  • Strong work ethic with the ability to take initiative, function in a fast-paced working environment, with immediate and changing deadlines.
  • Ability to prioritize workload, with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and time management are a must.
  • Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to interact comfortably and effectively with managers and employees at all levels within our company.
  • Fluency in English
  • Ability to operate independently and proactively with little or no supervision.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!

Our Perks:

We offer medical, dental, and vision plans that cover you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children. Life insurance, parental leave, plus short-term and long-term disability coverage are also available. Riot will support your retirement benefits with a company match, and double down on your donations of time and money to non-profit charitable organizations. Balance between work and personal life is encouraged with open paid time off, and a play fund so you can broaden and deepen your personal relationship with games.

Because together we are better

It's our policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and members of Riot Games. We know that fresh and varied perspectives will make us better at what we do, so however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, we're excited to hear from you. Don't be discouraged if you feel you don't fully meet every single one of the requirements for a particular role, there's always room for growth at. Riot. If this role excites you and aligns with your passion for entertainment and live production, we’re eager to hear from you.

Vagas afirmativas são oportunidades exclusivas destinadas a aumentar a representatividade em nosso time de tecnologia. Estas vagas visam garantir a diversidade de talentos, ideias e experiências, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho mais inclusivo e acolhedor. title: Data & Insights Manager
description:
Teads is the omnichannel outcomes platform for the open internet, driving full-funnel results for marketers across premium media. With a focus on meaningful business outcomes for branding and performance objectives, the combined company ensures value is driven with every media dollar by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context-driven addressability and measurement. One of the most scaled advertising platforms on the open internet, Teads is directly partnered with more than 10,000 publishers and 20,000 advertisers globally. The company is headquartered in New York, with a global team of nearly 1,800 people in 36 countries.

Working very cross-functionally on an international scale, the Teads Data & Intelligence team is responsible for building solid data and measurement solutions for our clients to help deliver Teads media solutions and help determine their effectiveness.

In this role you will be balancing research projects for clients and agencies leveraging our measurement solutions and or working closely with sales to help build audience proposals using Teads data and insights tools. You will develop and maintain relationship with different research and data vendors ranging from Nielsen and Kantar Millward Brown to Retargetly and GWI.

You will be working across Teads’ diverse range of clients, spanning from tech to retail, from telecommunications to FMCG. We liaise daily with the Sales, Marketing, CX, Ad-Ops, Publishing and Studio teams.

The work environment is very informal and dynamic, perfect for a hands-on, proactive person who doesn’t shy away from picking up the phone or arranging a meeting to get the job done effectively.

The ideal candidate is proactive, has high standards of client service and a consultative solutions selling approach.

What will you do?

  • Lead data, insights and measurement efforts across the BR market.
  • Manage and allocate the research budget effectively throughout the fiscal year
  • Respond to request for brief (RFP) where data related solutions are required (most importantly, audience and contextual based solutions).
  • Coordinate and deliver on all required measurement and effectiveness studies and solutions in the BR market.
  • Address requests for information (RFI) where advertisers and or agencies are looking for data related questionnaires and when privacy, regulatory information is required.
  • Attend, present and advocate for Teads data and measurement solutions to client and agency partners in the BR.
  • Support BR sales and service teams on existing and new data and measurement solutions to aid in the sell, upsell and cross sell of Teads’ media products.
  • Partnering with local marketing and sales to promote Teads data solutions in the form of case studies, thought leadership, blog posts, insights generation and more.

What will you bring to the team?

  • Significant experience in the digital media and advertising industry.
  • Experience of programmatic media buying (and or selling). This involves understanding how media is bought and sold and where data is applied in the process.
  • Understanding and practical experience of the setup, activation, analysis and delivery of campaign measurement and effectiveness solutions (ranging from brand lift to attention)
  • Understanding of data solutions that include but aren’t limited to; audience (demographic, behavioural, interest) and contextual targeting and measurement principles. Additional knowledge of targeting options for CTV would be an advantage.
  • Experience working with first- and third-party data to develop audience targeting strategies and insights-driven recommendations.
  • Experience in working at any of the following: media agency, advertiser marketing team (with digital responsibilities), digital publisher, media owner (e.g. broadcaster) and/or digital marketing company (e.g. data vendor, DSP, SSP) to enable a strong understanding of the agency media buying process, including collaboration with strategists, planners, and activation teams.
  • You connect with our values:
    • Relentless Customer Focus: You put customers at the heart of everything, building strong relationships, understanding customers needs, and making decisions that keep their perspective front and center.
    • Act Today, Not Tomorrow: You make smart decisions quickly, prioritize action over perfection, and keep things moving forward, even when things aren’t 100% clear.
    • Obsess About Outcomes: You’re outcome-driven, take ownership of your results, and work through challenges to deliver what really matters.
    • Evolve Through Change: You’re adaptable, curious, and see change as a chance to learn and improve. You evolve your skills to keep up and push ahead.
    • Human-driven, Powered by AI: While we use AI to drive performance, it’s our people who make the real difference. You bring empathy, collaboration, and a love of learning to everything you do.

Please submit your CV in English.

Job description

Você manja de cronogramas, adora um bom planejamento e se sente em casa entre planilhas e projetos? Gosta de colocar ordem na casa, conectar áreas e garantir que tudo aconteça no tempo certo, com qualidade? Então essa vaga é pra você!

Na Moderna, somos apaixonados por educação e inovação, e estamos em busca de uma pessoa organizada, analítica e proativa para somar ao nosso time editorial!

Nossa área de Planejamento Editorial é o coração que organiza e dá ritmo à produção dos nossos materiais didáticos – dos livros físicos aos recursos digitais, com foco no mercado público.

Somos responsáveis por coordenar o fluxo de ponta a ponta: elaboramos cronogramas de novos projetos, fazemos interface com áreas como Produção Industrial, Supply Chain e Fiscal, gerenciamos alocação de custos, solicitamos fichas catalográficas, registramos ISBNs e muito mais. Tudo isso com o objetivo de garantir que nossos conteúdos cheguem às mãos de alunos e professores com excelência e no tempo certo.

Nosso grande desafio este ano? Otimizar ainda mais nossos processos e fortalecer a gestão dos nossos projetos editoriais. E é aí que você entra!


Main responsibilities

•Controlar, acompanhar e atualizar os cronogramas de produção editorial, em parceria com as áreas de editorial, arte e conteúdo digital;

•Manter planilhas e sistemas atualizados, com atenção aos detalhes e foco na organização das informações;

a Steck, acreditamos no poder do impacto. Ele inspira nossos colaboradores e colaboradoras a se tornarem agentes de transformação e embaixadores de uma visão compartilhada: sermos #IMPACTMAKER.

#Inclusão: Somos criadores de impacto na inclusão, porque abraçamos perspectivas diversas, cocriando um ambiente onde todos pertençam e prosperem.

#Maestria: Somos criadores de impacto na maestria, porque contamos com nossa experiência e conhecimento para trazer inovações da mais alta qualidade.

#Ação: Somos criadores de impacto na ação, porque atuamos com responsabilidade, agilidade e integridade, sempre com o cliente em mente.

#Curiosidade : Somos criadores de impacto na curiosidade, porque adoramos pensar de forma diferenciada e abrangente, desafiando o cenário atual e aprendendo todos os dias.

#Trabalho em Equipe: Somos criadores de impacto no trabalho em equipe, porque alcançamos resultados com nossas equipes, trabalhando em colaboração, com transparência e confiança.

Imagine-se entrando em um mundo repleto de energia e possibilidades, onde cada interruptor, cada fio e cada ligação, uma possibilidade de evolução de carreira profissional!

Golpe da Falsa Vaga de Emprego. A Steck está ligada e alerta VOCÊ que não realiza qualquer tipo de cobrança para participação em seus processos seletivos. A STECK tem conhecimento de que pessoas estão sendo contatadas por terceiros que, de forma fraudulenta, se apresentam em nome da companhia de recrutamento e seleção para oferecer vagas de emprego, exigindo o pagamento de taxas ou a realização de cursos pagos como condição para contratação.

Fique atento! Trata-se de um golpe! A Steck já está tomando as medidas cabíveis para investigar e coibir esse tipo de prática.

Reforçamos que todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho são divulgadas exclusivamente pelos canais oficiais da empresa, como nosso site institucional ou , redes sociais ( @steckeletrica ou @stecklatam ) e com perfis verificados em plataformas de recrutamento.

Não abra e-mails, mensagens, não atenda ligações ou clique em links suspeitos, não pague boletos ou faça PIX para desconhecidos.

Orientamos que qualquer abordagem suspeita seja desconsiderada e, se possível, denunciada às autoridades competentes.

Em caso de dúvidas, os candidatos podem entrar em contato com a STECK por meio de seus canais oficiais de comunicação, através do ou telefone: +55 (11) 4090-2121 .

title: Compliance & Legal Sr Manager in São Paulo, Brazil
description:
Who we are:
At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America - where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.


R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing and buy now pay later for business customers). We are a tight knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant, J.P. Morgan, and Ualá. We are backed by world-class investors such as Gradient Ventures (Google’s AI-focused fund), COMETA, General Catalyst, Hi Ventures, Y Combinator, Femsa Ventures, Prosus, Endeavor Catalyst, among others.


As a Compliance & Legal Sr Manager in Brazil, you will be the primary point of contact for all local legal and regulatory matters. You’ll play a strategic role in supporting our growth in Brazil, ensuring regulatory compliance, structuring financial products, and enabling compliant operations across the business. A key part of this role is ensuring that all regulatory requirements, including filings, audits, and requests from supervisory authorities, are handled thoroughly and timely. You will collaborate with Product, Risk, Finance, and Engineering teams, and manage top-tier external counsel relationships as needed.


What you'll do:


Legal

  • Draft, review, and localize contracts, terms and conditions, NDAs, powers of attorney, and commercial agreements.
  • Support the legal structuring of financial products under Brazilian regulation.
  • Coordinate with external legal advisors and cartórios on corporate and regulatory matters.
  • Advise internal teams on legal implications of operational and strategic initiatives.

Compliance

  • Implement and maintain internal compliance policies related to ethics, data protection (LGPD), financial regulation, and consumer rights.
  • Monitor financial regulation in Brazil (e.g., Banco Central, CVM, Receita Federal, CAD, SENACON) and assess potential impact.
  • Lead R2’s compliance obligations, including reporting to regulators and ensuring accurate registry in applicable systems (e.g., SCR, SISCOR).
  • Oversee KYC/AML processes for clients, partners, and vendors, including onboarding and transaction monitoring.
  • Support internal and external audits, compliance testing, and internal controls.
  • Ensure proper credit reporting to Brazilian credit bureaus (e.g., Serasa, Boa Vista) in accordance with applicable laws.
  • Support the implementation and ongoing monitoring of digital onboarding and KYC flows.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, integrity, and accountability across the organization.

Who you are:

  • Law degree with 5+ years of experience in legal and/or compliance roles, preferably in fintechs, SCDs/SEPs, banks, or law firms focused on financial services.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian financial regulation, data protection (LGPD), AML/CFT requirements, and consumer protection frameworks.
  • Proven ability to operate with autonomy, manage risk, and drive compliance in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Professional fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Based in São Paulo or available for regular presence in our local office.

What We Offer

  • The chance to join a high-impact, mission-driven fintech with regional scale.
  • Leadership over critical legal and compliance matters in Brazil.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with exceptional teams across Latin America.

Working at Appear

Be part of a growing global company and experience cross-cultural collaboration in a diverse and dynamic work environment, with over 30 different nationalities at our office today!

Application deadline: August 4th

Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, Appear is a leader in live production technology, specialising in high-capacity, sustainable solutions for media processing and content delivery. Our portfolio is designed to support the most complex scenarios of live event contribution, adapting seamlessly to the ever-evolving dynamics of the media, entertainment, and sports industries.

Our extensive client base, including world-leading content creators like NBCUniversal, Warner Bros. Discovery, Formula 1, NHL, and Riot Games, rely on our solutions to deliver the highest profile live media with utmost integrity and efficiency. This trust underscores our position at the pinnacle of live production technology, where our commitment to excellence and innovation meets the critical demands of the most prestigious live events worldwide.

Founded in 2004, Appear has established itself as a leader in the industry. Thanks to our world-renowned team of experts and their relentless emphasis on modularity and functional versatility, we are at the forefront of innovation in live production technology.

We actively participate with key industry bodies and technology partners to drive the advancement of standardisation and foster continuous innovation. Our excellence is internationally recognised through numerous accolades, including the prestigious NAB Excellence in Sustainability Award and TVBEurope’s Best in Market, celebrating our achievements in sustainability and technological leadership.

Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.

Our Mission is to recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. We love to promote from within - more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs - they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!

Job Description

The Product Manager for Brazil is a strategic leader responsible for delivering innovative, scalable solutions that support business operations and enable business growth. This role provides vision, strategy, and roadmaps for Brazil’s systems, data, and technology needs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable value delivery. The PM collaborates closely with Brazil Product and Service teams, Brazil Leadership, Business Operations and IS to advocate for enterprise technology needs and consistent processes. By translating business requirements into actionable plans and fostering strong alignment between business and technical teams, the Product Manager drives continuous improvement and operational excellence. Ideal candidates will excel in aligning business strategy with technology development efforts, engaging stakeholders, and prioritizing work based on business value.

Successful Product Managers are expected to be strategic thinkers, strong communicators, and effective collaborators. They must balance customer and district needs with technical feasibility, prioritize based on business impact, and lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

Strategic Systems Leadership

Provide vision, strategy, and roadmaps for systems, data, and technology needs across Brazil. Align product initiatives with business goals and ensure that development efforts deliver measurable value.

Collaborate with Brazil Product and Service teams and Brazil Leadership to drive strategic alignment and execution.

Serve as a key liaison between Brazil and Americas Product & Service teams. Advocate for enterprise technology needs and ensure Brazil’s systems and processes align with broader regional and global strategies. Partner with other Americas Product Managers to incorporate Brazil-specific needs and challenges into enterprise systems roadmaps.

Enable Technology Scalability

Champion consistent business processes across Brazil to enable scalable technology development. Help define and optimize workflows that support operational excellence and long-term system sustainability.

Business Engagement & Requirements Translation

Act as the voice of the district by engaging stakeholders to uncover needs and translate them into well-defined, actionable requirements. Facilitate continuous exploration and ensure that business priorities are clearly reflected in IS product backlogs and development plans.

Planning, Prioritization & Delivery Oversight

Define and maintain strategic roadmaps that contains the capabilities and features required for a successful operation. Prioritize initiatives based on business value and cost, and oversee release planning, adoption, and post-release enhancements.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including district teams, technical partners, and business leadership. Ensure transparency and alignment through regular communication and feedback loops. Share responsibility for overall solution delivery and employee satisfaction of our technology.

Support Agile process to accelerate value delivery. Provide development teams with clear requirements, business support and support iterative planning and execution. Collect and analyze user feedback and usage data to inform continuous improvement and innovation.

Third-Party Systems & Vendor Management

Own the roadmap and lifecycle of third-party systems supporting Brazil’s operations. Manage relationships with external service providers, ensuring alignment with business needs, performance expectations, and compliance standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Logistics, or a related field.

Proven ability to define, maintain, and communicate strategic product roadmaps.

Demonstrated experience in gathering business requirements and translating them into actionable development plans.

Ability to prioritize initiatives based on business value, strategic alignment, and resource availability.

Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with a track record of successful cross-functional collaboration.

Fluent in both Portuguese and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.

Analytical mindset with the ability to assess business needs, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend scalable, value-driven solutions.

Experience in release planning, managing user feedback, and supporting post-release enhancements.

Job description

Se você tem como valores agir eticamente e com transparência, buscar resultados mantendo a perpetuidade, agir com humanidade em todos os tipos de relacionamentos, buscar inovar e está em constante transformação, a Logber Logística do Grupo Bertolini é para você!

Inscreva-se e faça parte da nossa equipe.


Main responsibilities

  • Gerenciar as atividades da área comercial, planejando, organizando, acompanhando, controlando, orientando e liderando de forma transparente e participativa o desenvolvimento das atividades, inteirando-se de problemas, avaliando as soluções adotadas, discutindo, propondo e definindo estratégias e ações para a implementação de melhorias nos processos, visando atingir resultados definidos pela empresa.
  • Responder pela gestão das equipes comercial, orientado pelos valores, processos, políticas e procedimentos de gestão de pessoas, a fim de promover o desenvolvimento comportamental e a qualificação técnica, assim como a melhoria do clima organizacional.
  • Responder pela gestão e pelos resultados do processos Comercial/Vendas, através de planejamento e implementação dos mesmos, estabelecendo e monitorando os indicadores, acompanhando-os e gerando as ações pertinentes para atingir e superar os resultados planejados, orientados pelas estratégias, diretrizes e políticas da organização.
  • Participar da definição e elaborar estratégias para venda dos serviços, considerando e definindo forma de atuação e perfil dos profissionais para atendimento do mercado, a fim de garantir o aumento da participação da empresa no mercado (market share), fortalecimento da marca e/ou fidelização do cliente.
  • Estabelecer, acompanhar e cobrar o cumprimento do plano de metas de vendas, conforme informações comerciais, analisando possibilidades, faturamento, campanhas e demais ações, visando atender objetivos de crescimento da empresa.
  • Elaborar política de precificação dentro do direcionamento da estratégia comercial, validar com a direção, disseminar junto a equipe e prezar pelo cumprimento da mesma.

Requirements and skills

  • Pós Graduação

title: Americas Senior Accountant (M/W/D)
description:
Experienced accountant managing the treasury and accounting aspects of a scope of entities in the Americas and supporting finance analyses as long as the development of the finance framework (processes, tools, …).

In an international environment, you are expected to proceed the compliance of the entities of your scope (including accounting, financial & tax compliance, …) while accompanying the evolutions of the scope.

Responsibilities:

Scope

  • Handle accounting of several legal entities in the Americas Region
  • Handle payment procedures for several entities of the Americas Region
  • Support process, tools and practices development and implementation

Accounting

  • Handle day-to-day accounting on SAGE for several legal entities in the Americas scope
  • Prepare general ledger entries/balances and identify anomalies
  • Prepare monthly Trial Balance, Balance Sheet & P&L reports
  • Prepare reporting of accounts on monthly, quarterly, and yearly basis
  • Proceed with compliance with local GAAPs
  • Assist corporate teams on need basis for global consolidation of accounts
  • Support financial audits and limited reviews
  • Coordinate with external firms and consultants related to finance work
  • Implement financial controls and systems in coordination with corporate teams

Treasury

  • Support bank operability with corporate treasury team
  • Proceed with payment processes
  • Monitor funding needs

Compliance

  • Coordinate the external firm for statutory, regulatory and tax compliance (e.g. yearly Financial Statements, VAT, corporate income tax, …)
  • Support, with an external firm, the statutory/tax/transfer pricing audits
  • Monitor communication and relationship with local administrations

Others

  • Support business teams in their needs on financial/administrative topics
  • Support projects and requests from other departments, units and subsidiaries of the Company for various activities
  • Identify control issues, errors and efficiency opportunities

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Education – Finance/Audit/Accounting
  • 10-years minimum of Experience in accounting preferably with an experience in an international group

Mandatory Skills:

  • Ability to autonomously manage accounting and coordinate with third-party provider to ensure compliance of a local entity
  • Ability to work in a dynamic environment such as lack of well-defined procedures and changing work mix
  • Will to improve the finance framework of the dedicated scope
  • Fluent written and verbal communication in English and people skill is essential

Additional Information

We are committed to having a workforce that is representative of the community it serves at all levels of theorganisation. We, therefore, welcome applications from all backgrounds and all sections ofthe community regardless of age, disability, gender, race, religion and sexual orientation.

Set the tone with us

Working at Believe means having individual and collective impact in a fast-growing company!

At all stages of their careers, Believers are an important part of what we are doing: shaping the future of the music industry.

We need teams that truly reflect the diversity of our clients: our international presence is an inspiring and enriching work environment for each one of us, with daily opportunities to connect with ourcolleagues all over the world.

We have two hearts at Believe – our People and our Artists.

We believe in THE POWER OF OUR PEOPLE, who grow every day to develop their potential… We aim to provide our Believers with the best environment to thrive.

ROCK THE JOB

A wellness program “Pauses” with many activities and animations in-house

Access toEutelmed, a digital mental health andwell-beingplatform that allows you to speak with an experienced psychologist

A healthy and eco-responsible company restaurant

Individual or family health insurance

A rooftop

A gym with free classes

SING IN HARMONY

Ambassadorprogram: an employeevolunteering initiative dedicated to all Believers interested in having a positive impact on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion(DEI),wellbeingand theplanet.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Regulatory Requirements
description:
About Nubank

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world.

Today, Nubank is a global company, with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in Sao Paulo, by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit

About the team

The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks, and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership.

GRC squad is responsible for collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to drive alignment between our technology security strategy and Nubank's overall objectives. We ensure that identified risks are mitigated, empowering risk-based decision-making by leadership both within and beyond the IT and Security Business Unit.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you will:

  • Analyze and interpret new IT and Security regulatory requirements across various geolocations in which the company operates.
  • Stay up-to-date with regulatory changes and emerging trends, assessing their impact on IT and Security processes.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to design and implement solutions that ensure compliance with regulatory mandates.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation and internal policies, including regulatory impact assessments, project plans, and compliance reports.
  • Engage with cross-functional teams to provide guidance and expertise on regulatory requirements and compliance strategies.
  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities within the internal controls landscape.
  • Work closely with the Risk teams to align on mitigation of identified risks.
  • Prepare and present detailed reports on assessment findings, risks, and recommendations to senior management.
  • Work in a multidisciplinary and global team, interacting with teams mainly in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

We are looking for a professional who has:

  • Prior experience with internal controls, risk, and compliance initiatives.
  • Knowledge of international banking regulations and compliance standards, focusing on IT and Security requirements.
  • Experience in regulatory analysis, or a related field within the banking or financial services industry.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing compliance processes, coupled with a comprehensive understanding of the regulatory landscape, including but not limited to SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, SFC, Banxico, ANBIMA, SEC, and other relevant regulations.
  • Familiarity with diverse cybersecurity domains and concepts such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27k family, NIST, ITIL, COBIT and similar frameworks.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of articulating complex regulatory concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in technical assessment, with the ability to effectively collaborate with engineers, business process owners, and other stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency for both written and spoken communication.

Role Location

NWW

Benefits

  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Meal allowance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program
  • Gympass partnership
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • ‘Espaço Feijão’- Private nursing and breastfeeding spaces in our buildings
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nubank, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

Your solutions won’t just be functional—they’ll be impactful and user-friendly, strengthening long-term customer relationships.

If you enjoymeeting people, collaborating in person, and making an impact globally ,this is the role for you!
  • Build smarter tools & automation – Developinternal tools and frameworks to streamline and simplify integrations, making them more scalable and efficient for future clients.
  • Career Growth & Leadership – As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into a leadership role andpotentially build your own team in the future .

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • Strong communication skills and experience interacting with customers and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in building integration tools and APIs.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, data formats (JSON, XML), and authentication methods (OAuth).

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. We thrive on working together, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

  • Direct and Speedy: we move quickly, experiment boldly, and get things done today, not tomorrow. Feedback is candid, and the drive for constant improvement is part of our DNA.
  • Ideas > Titles: We believe the best ideas win, regardless of who they come from. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it.
  • Embrace a Sports Team Mentality: We're only competitive externally, and very collaborative internally. Everyone plays a vital role, and together, we win as a team.
