title: Página da Vaga | Banco de Talentos - Para Economistas
description:
Esse é um Banco de Talentos exclusivo para pessoas formadas em economia.

Estamos sempre em busca de talentos para enriquecer nossa equipe; a ideia é reunir talentos que façam sentindo para futuras oportunidades.

A posição de analista demanda boa capacidade de escrita e habilidades em desenvolver trabalhos analíticos, além de conhecimentos específicos de cada área da LCA, como estatística, econometria, microeconomia, macroeconomia, avaliação econômico-financeira.

Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, criatividade, liderança, proatividade, comprometimento, flexibilidade, colaboração, resiliência, curiosidade, capacidade analítica, diferentes perfis e investimos nas fortalezas individuais.

O preenchimento da futura vaga entre analista júnior, pleno ou sênior dependerá das experiências prévias, qualificações e perfil do(a) candidato(a).

As oportunidades poderão ser no formato híbrido ou remoto, conforme a necessidade de cada área.

Se você se identifica com a LCA, cadastre-se no nosso Banco de Talentos e lembre-se de manter o seu perfil atualizado. Fazemos uma triagem entre currículos cadastrados toda vez que uma vaga é aberta; reforçamos, porém, que alguns currículos podem acabar não sendo selecionados nessa triagem e a atualização do perfil também envolve a candidatura a vagas específicas.

Importante: por se tratar de um Banco de Talentos, não temos nenhuma previsão definitiva de quando a posição será aberta. Por isso, fique atento aos canais de comunicação.

A LCA é a maior consultoria econômica do Brasil. Atende clientes nacionais e internacionais nas áreas de finanças e em análises econômicas que envolvem regulação, políticas públicas, litígios, entre outros.

São aproximadamente 50 economistas, que atuam de forma integrada, agregando sinergias para o desenvolvimento de trabalhos de excelência.

Somos a única consultoria da América Latina ranqueada no Global Competition Review 100 e no Latin Lawyer 250.

Atribuímos o nosso sucesso à equipe, que une habilidades diversificadas e engajamento no trabalho em equipe.

O envolvimento em projetos é profundo, completo e imediato. O treinamento é na realidade. O ambiente é colaborativo, você sempre terá o suporte de todos.

Buscamos sempre construir um ótimo lugar para trabalhar e valorizamos o equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Respeitamos a individualidade e damos muita atenção a situações pessoais.

Atuamos pela diversidade e inclusão na LCA

A LCA valoriza a diversidade e incentiva a candidatura de pessoas que fazem parte dos grupos subrepresentados no mercado de trabalho: mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIA+, PCD e outros.

Desde setembro de 2021 temos um programa estruturado para promover a diversidade e um ambiente inclusivo. Temos atuado em governança, engajamento interno e atração e desenvolvimento de talentos com diversidade.

Promovemos conversas e palestras periódicas com pessoas convidadas de outras empresas e líderes de movimentos pro-diversidade.

Instituímos o Comitê de Inclusão e Diversidade que, aliado à alta direção, realizou o levantamento da situação das mulheres na LCA – que têm forte presença na liderança –; o censo de diversidade; e depois de um ano de programa, a pesquisa de inclusão e respeito pessoal e profissional.

Com base no que aprendemos, publicamos o Guia de boas práticas em respeito e inclusão, que você podeconsultar aqui .

Revimos nossas práticas de recrutamento e seleção com vistas a atrair e promover a diversidade. Estamos ativamente buscando pessoas não só de variadas características, como de diversas origens, formações e lugares de morada.

Nos primeiros doze meses do programa conseguimos contratar uma proporção três vezes maior de pessoas negras e LGBT em relação à média anterior – chegando a mais de 30% de representação de cada um desses grupos nas novas contratações.

Nossas pessoas pertencentes a grupos de diversidade recomendam a LCA para pessoas como elas trabalharem –veja aqui um resumo dos resultados da pesquisa. Estamos no começo, temos muito o que aprender e melhorar, e estes primeiros resultados só nos encorajam a seguir em frente.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
Brex is the AI-powered spend platform. We help companies spend with confidence with integrated corporate cards, banking, and global payments, plus intuitive software for travel and expenses. Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises — including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass — use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Brex empowers the next generation of businesses with an integrated corporate card and spend management software. We make it easy for our customers to manage every aspect of spending and empower their employees to make better financial decisions from anywhere they live or work. Brex proudly serves tens of thousands of growing businesses, from early-stage startups to enterprise leaders.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

The Engineering team includes Data, IT, Security, and Software, and is responsible for building innovative products and infrastructure for Brex and our customers. We believe that engineers should accelerate the business through technology, and collaborate across multiple teams to accomplish that.

Teams are autonomous, value inclusivity, eager to learn, teach and constantly improve how things work. The software we build today is the foundation for dozens of Brex systems in the future, so engineers have a strong sense of ownership and accountability and take pride in their craft.

What you’ll do

Brex is seeking a fiercely organized and highly skilled procurement manager to lead IT Procurement. We are looking for someone who is versatile in nature, with the ability to tackle challenges while maintaining an even keel and sense of humor. This person oversees Brex's management and renewal of over $20m in SaaS & Managed Service vendors contracts. They will be confident in their ability to coordinate global contracts and budgets within set deadlines, organize and facilitate meetings, and maintain expectations amongst internal and external stakeholders. This person will be responsible for autonomously establishing and maintaining positive relationships with various teams in the company, while ensuring timely and efficient contract lifecycle management delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Manage Procurement analysts assisting with workloads
  • Autonomously manage IT vendor relationships, including contracts, negotiations, terms and renewals
  • Manage and improve our intake process for software that ensures we’re buying the right things, and helps streamline end to end vendor onboarding
  • Manage SaaS spend across multiple budgets, including forecasting and actuals
  • Build strong relationships across group budget owners including Engineering,Finance, Legal, HR, Go To Market, and Security
  • Clearly & concisely communicate complex information to disparate audiences.
  • Manage and improve our global software catalog

Requirements

  • 6+ years of work experience
  • Strong contract management and negotiation skills. You’re able to work with vendors to get the terms we want, and the best possible deals
  • Excellent organizational and process building skills. You can create and improve processes and get buy-in from others
  • Extraordinary relationship-building skills with the ability to engage and influence others toward achieving common goals
  • Experience in project planning and delivery; being able to identify a problem, and map out the scope of work and stakeholders to arrive at a scalable solution
  • Excellent analytical skills for managing our KPIs and creating data visualizations
  • Experience using Ironclad
  • Experience working with DocuSign
  • Experience using Coupa
  • Experience working at a tech start-up environment

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with abrex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Who we are?

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

Job Description

The successful candidate for the Test Automation Consultant position will be working as a part of a high-performance Scrum teams. They will:

  • Work closely with other teams, analyse testing processes, and propose improvements.
  • Train Test Engineers and help to spread good practises across the organisation.
  • Be responsible for setting up Test Automation framework for multiple solution deliveries.
  • Apply quality engineering principles throughout Agile product lifecycle.
  • Clearly and effectively communicate with different stakeholders.
  • Participate in Quality Guild workshops and training sessions to spread the word about Test Automation Best Practices.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: (to be specified for each position)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or similarly related field.
  • Proficiency in English is a must
  • 5+ years of professional Test Automation Engineer experience.
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced and challenging environment.
  • Strong problem-solving ability.
  • BDD & ATDD experience.
  • Experience testing Web Services: RESTFul, SOAP.
  • Familiar with GIT, Selenium Web Driver, SoapUI, Postman, Playwright, Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices.

Additional Information

Monday to Friday - 8:00 to 17:00 Hybrid Work

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. title: Bombeiros apagam incêndio na BR-262, o prenúncio da temporada do fogo
description:
Bombeiros apagam incêndio na BR-262, o prenúncio da temporada do fogo

Vegetação seca e o clima seco contribuem para o avanço rápido das chamas, o que dificulta o combate ao fogo

O Corpo de Bombeiros de Mato Grosso do Sul atendeu quatro ocorrências de incêndio em Corumbá nas últimas 24 horas, sinalizando o início da temporada de queimadas no estado. As ocorrências foram registradas em terrenos baldios, na região central e às margens da BR-262. Segundo o Inpe, o estado já registrou 87 focos de incêndio nos primeiros dez dias de julho, com Corumbá liderando em número de ocorrências. A vegetação seca e o clima árido contribuem para a rápida propagação das chamas, levando as autoridades a pedirem que a população evite queimadas.

Com a chegada do período de estiagem, o número de incêndios em vegetação voltou a preocupar em Mato Grosso do Sul. Nas últimas 24 horas, o Corpo de Bombeiros atendeu quatro ocorrências de fogo em áreas urbanas e rurais de Corumbá, distante 428 quilômetros de Campo Grande. A vegetação seca e o clima seco contribuem para o avanço rápido das chamas, o que dificulta o combate.

Conforme a corporação, as ocorrências foram registradas nos seguintes locais: na Rua Agostinho Mônaco, no Bairro Guaicurus (terreno baldio); na Rua Monte Castelo, no Bairro Aeroporto (terreno baldio); na Praça da República, região central (incêndio em amontoado de lixo próximo a um bambuzal); e na BR-262, no trecho do anel viário próximo ao aeroporto (fogo às margens da rodovia).

Os Bombeiros explicam que, neste período, a vegetação fica mais desidratada e inflamável, o que facilita que pequenos focos de fogo se transformem rapidamente em incêndios de média ou grande proporção. “O clima seco e o tipo de vegetação contribuem para a rápida propagação das chamas e dificultam a extinção”, alertam.

A corporação reforça o pedido para que a população evite a queima de lixo, entulho e restos de poda, prática que além de ilegal, pode provocar incêndios descontrolados e colocar vidas em risco.

De acordo com dados do Inpe (Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais), entre os dias 1º e 10 de julho, já foram registrados 87 focos de incêndio no Estado. O município com maior número de ocorrências é Corumbá, com 11 focos, seguido por Aquidauana e Coxim, com 8 cada, e Ribas do Rio Pardo, com 7. MS já está em estado de atenção devido à estiagem, que historicamente aumenta o risco de incêndios florestais, principalmente no Pantanal .

Nos próximos 10 dias, não há indicativo de chuvas significativas no Estado e a previsão é de baixos índices de umidade relativa do ar, entre 20% e 40%, segundo boletim divulgado pelo Imasul (Instituto de Meio Ambiente de Mato Grosso do Sul).

A estiagem, de acordo com o órgão, é decorrente da atuação de sistema de alta pressão atmosférica, que inibe a formação de nuvens e ocorrência de chuvas. A presença do ar seco favorece elevadas amplitudes térmicas, ou seja, grande diferença entre as temperaturas mínimas e máximas do dia, podendo atingir diferença de até 20 graus.

description:
Job description

Quem somos

A Smarthis é uma Tech startup que desenvolve soluções feitas de humanos para humanos! Acreditamos que boas soluções surgem de fortes conexões entre pessoas, conhecimentos, ideias e ideais. Por isso, ser Smarther é mais do que fazer parte de uma empresa, é viver verdadeiramente a cultura da colaboração e inovação que pulsa em nosso DNA.

Com um time formado por diferentes gêneros, cores, crenças, culturas e orientações afetivas, que estão espalhados por todo o Brasil (e mundo!), nosso objetivo é auxiliar nossos clientes em seus desafios para a transformação digital. Desenvolvendo produtos e serviços tecnológicos para seus negócios, combinando o melhor do RPA (Robotic Process Automation), Data Analytics e Inteligência Artificial, por um time que tem paixão por inovação, desafios e aprendizado.

Nossos Diferenciais:

Somos Great Place to Work – O respeito e o cuidado com o nosso time foram fundamentais para conquistarmos a premiação: desde 2021, somos reconhecidos anualmente como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Isso é resultado da união de um time com uma cultura alinhada com a nossa visão de crescimento para o futuro.

100 Startups to Watch – Estamos na lista das startups mais promissoras e inovadoras do ecossistema do Brasil, segundo a Pequenas Empresas e Grandes Negócios. O desenvolvimento das equipes e a maturidade para encontrar soluções nos trouxeram essa premiação importante.

UiPath Professional Services & Diamond Partner – Somos a primeira empresa da América Latina a alcançar as principais certificações da empresa líder mundial em RPA.

One Hundred Startups – Somos reconhecidos como uma das 100 startups mais relevantes em ecossistemas corporativos de inovação, pela 100 Open Startups, a plataforma pioneira e líder de Open Innovation.

Scale-Up Endeavor – Acelerados pela Endeavor, a comunidade global líder de empreendedores de alto impacto, fazemos parte do programa de aceleração das empresas que mais crescem no Brasil, levando a transformação digital para o mercado

Onde Estamos:

Atualmente, temos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Miami, Buenos Aires, Madrid, Cidade do México e Perth. Mas não se preocupe! Para os que estiverem trabalhando remotamente, nossa cultura permanece a mesma: Integração total com happy hour online, noite de jogos, lives e outras programações legais!


Main responsibilities

Seu trabalho será

  • Atuar como perfil "outside sales" com portfólio de São Paulo;
  • Contactar e nutrir prospects e leads;
  • Acompanhar e conduzir reuniões comerciais;
  • Elaborar apresentações e propostas comerciais;
  • Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos com leads e clientes;
  • Contribuir no fechamento de vendas para crescimento do negócio;
  • Acompanhar e atuar sobre o ciclo de vida dos leads e clientes;
  • Aprimorar processos comerciais e abordagem de forma contínua;
  • Entender sobre o mercado, indústrias, leads, clientes, personas, decisores e soluções do portfólio;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar métricas, a fim de identificar oportunidades.

Requirements and skills

O que você precisa ter

  • Comunicação (oral e escrita) bem estruturada, com capacidade de argumentação e entendimento sobre o que o cliente precisa;
  • Habilidades interpessoais e capacidade de estabelecer e manter relacionamentos de confiança e duradouros com leads e clientes;
  • Conhecimento em Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Capacidade analítica;
  • Proatividade e mentalidade de melhoria contínua;
  • Inglês avançado, podendo ser necessário usar no dia a dia;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de forma híbrida na região de São Paulo.

Excelente se tiver

  • Experiência em vendas e planejamento comercial para o contexto B2B;
  • Técnicas de vendas, oratória, storytelling e negociação;
  • Experiência na gestão de carteira e retenção de clientes;
  • Experiência comercial com produto digital / SaaS;
  • Experiência de trabalho em startup;
  • Customer Development, Customer Success e metodologias de experiência do cliente (ex.: Personas e User Story Mapping);
  • Estratégia de Marketing e Marketing Digital;
  • Experiência com CRM;
  • Participação ativa em comunidades na área de atuação: palestras, meetups, eventos, fóruns, talks, blogs, grupos, entre outros.

Additional information

O processo seletivo

A transparência é um de nossos princípios e por isso fazemos questão de compartilhar cada etapa da seleção. Dessa forma você já sabe o que esperar!

  1. Primeiro encontro: Alinhamento cultural
  2. Segundo encontro: Conversa com o gestor

Ah, e não se preocupe! Prezamos pela cultura do feedback e sabemos como uma resposta, seja ela positiva ou negativa, é fundamental. Portanto, ao final de cada etapa, você será informado se foi ou não aprovado no processo.

Nossos Valores e Incentivos

Aqui entendemos que o nosso principal ativo é você. Por isso, fazemos questão de proporcionar um ambiente seguro e confortável onde nossa equipe cresça e se desenvolva tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Pensando nisso, aqui estão alguns incentivos que oferecemos:

  • Participação dos lucros e resultados
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico
  • TotalPass
  • Cartão de benefícios flexíveis
  • Zenklub
  • Programa de Idiomas
  • Parceria com FIAP Escola de Tecnologia
  • Programa de treinamento
  • Plano de carreira definido
  • Horário flexível
  • Programa de mentoria
  • Licença parental estendida.

Além disso, temos também iniciativas internas de Live coding, Happy hours, esportes ao ar livre, Coding Dojo (treinamento gamificado), rodas de conversa, entre outros. Ou seja, atividades para todos os gostos!

E aí, deu match?! Então vem acelerar a revolução digital com a gente!

title: Co-founder técnico - Novas Teses Talentum
description:
️ Essa vaga é para as novas teses da Talentum. Focada em empresas que estão em fase de pré-criação e que serão lançadas em breve. Se você sonha em construir uma empresa B2B e SaaS do zero, queremos conversar com você!
Procuramos pessoas que tenham o potencial e o desejo de se tornarem um Cofundador(a) técnico hands-on em uma startup nascente. Reconhecemos que a experiência e o conhecimento para essa construção pode vir de diversas fontes, pois não há uma trajetória única por trás de jornadas bem-sucedidas de empreendedorismo.
️Abaixo, estão alguns dos caminhos que, se você viveu, indicam uma chance mais alta de alinhamento ao que buscamos, cada um com seu diferente nível de experiência e potencial.

  • Experiência empreendedora prévia: ter (co)fundado uma empresa real, que independente do seu sucesso, conseguiu construir um produto, gerar algumas vendas e reter clientes.
  • Experiência em startups de alto crescimento: ter feito parte do time fundador e/ou time inicial de uma startup que viveu uma jornada de alto crescimento, entre as fases mercadologicamente marcadas como "Pré-seed" a "Series B".
  • ️ Experiência em Big Techs: ter trabalhado em funções de alto impacto (técnicas ou gerenciais) em empresas de tecnologia de ponta.
  • Experiência em consultorias: ter trabalhado pelo menos 2 anos em uma empresa de consultoria de referência.
  • Experiência como liderança: ter liderado pessoas em algum nível (colaboradores individuais ou líderes) durante a jornada.
  • Início de carreira com disposição ao generalismo: pessoas com alto potencial e intensa motivação, com visão sistêmica, mas sem conexões com capital.
️Essa não é uma lista exaustiva de requisitos. Nossa principal busca é por pessoas com intensa motivação e dispostas a viver a jornada empreendedora, com todos os sacrifícios que ela envolve.
️ Procuramos pessoas para empreender, e não colaboradores individuais — portanto, é preciso ter disposição para viver os altos e baixos da jornada early stage, e, independente da função executiva, fazer o que for preciso para a empresa prosperar, desde papéis estratégicos até os operacionais.
Os Diferenciais Da Talentum
A Talentum atua como um Co-fundador ativo e mão-na-massa, além de ser o primeiro investidor. Trazemos vantagens competitivas únicas, que empresas nascidas sozinhas não têm:
  • Contamos com um time qualificado e multidisciplinar para construir junto com você. Atuamos lado a lado desde o início, com especialistas em tecnologia, jurídico, backoffice, financeiro, relacionamento com investidores e vendas. Oferecemos suporte estratégico e operacional para acelerar o desenvolvimento do negócio de forma sólida e conectada com o mercado.
  • Temos playbooks que detalham cada passo da operação de uma empresa nascente.
  • Acessamos uma rede de mentores experientes: sempre que desafios complexos surgem, temos à nossa disposição uma rede de mentores experientes da indústria para auxiliar na discussão, guiando os empreendedores para a solução do problema.
  • Somos os primeiros investidores da empresa: com nossa injeção de caixa, suportamos a operação da empresa durante os momentos iniciais, para que os fundadores possam buscar as primeiras fontes de receita enquanto constroem seus mínimos produtos viáveis e suas operações.
  • Boilerplate de tecnologia: você contará com um boilerplate + design system robusto disponibilizado pela Talentum, para acelerar o desenvolvimento dos produtos.

description:
Job description

O Omni Banco e Financeira, presente há 31 anos no mercado , é uma instituição sólida e reconhecida por possuir um dos melhores serviços de crédito do Brasil. Temos orgulho da nossa importância para pessoas com menor acesso a crédito. Por isso, empenhamos toda dedicação e responsabilidade para seguirmos adiante sempre, melhorando a Vida das Pessoas.

Nos dedicamos ao desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos colaboradores. Cultivamos relacionamentos com proximidade para criar vínculos com lealdade e parceria , com forte senso de fazer o que é correto , em um ambiente de respeito e cordialidade . Se você se identifica com este ambiente e se considera colaborativo , integrador e transformador , venha fazer parte do nosso time e voar com a gente!!!

Para isso, veja abaixo mais detalhes do que procuramos , os desafios que temos e o que você precisará possuir de conhecimento para fazer parte disso!


Main responsibilities

  • Gerenciar e garantir a operação contínua da infraestrutura de TI em ambientes AWS, Azure e/ou OCI, com foco em alta disponibilidade e resiliência.
  • Liderar equipes técnicas responsáveis por redes, servidores, armazenamento, backup, conectividade, cloud, automações e monitoramento.
  • Coordenar o NOC (Network Operations Center) e processos de escalonamento em regime 24x7.
  • Assegurar conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, continuidade de negócios e governança de TI(como ITIL, NIST, ISO 27001).
  • Gerir orçamento da área e apoiar a equipe de FinOps na execução do planejamento e controlar orçamentário, com foco em otimização de custos.
  • Liderar projetos de governança, modernização, automação (com ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible e Kubernets), e adoção de novas tecnologias.
  • Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs e SLAs).
  • Atuar como ponte entre times técnicos, áreas de negócio e fornecedores estratégicos.
  • Garantir a documentação, gestão de ativos e processos de mudanças, configuração e release.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua, gestão de riscos e cultura de excelência operacional.
  • Apoiar auditorias de segurança, continuidade de negócio e conformidade regulatória.

Requirements and skills

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de gestão pessoas ou tecnologia será um diferencial.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de times de infraestrutura, em regime 24x7 e em ambiente de missão crítica.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, Azure e OCI).
  • Conhecimento prático em Cloud Connect, redes híbridas e integração entre ambientes.
  • Conhecimento sólido em redes, virtualização, containers, banco de dados e segurança.
  • Familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), CI/CD, contêiner, ferramentas de automação e monitoramento.

Certificações desejáveis:

  • ITIL
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Administrator, OCI Foundations
  • FinOps Practitioner.

Attaché de coopération universitaire (F/H) - Ambassade de France au Brésil / Service de coopération et d'action culturelle / Antenne de São Paulo

Join to apply for the Attaché de coopération universitaire (F/H) role at Ministère des Affaires étrangères français .

Description synthétique du poste

Sous l’autorité du Conseiller de coopération et d’action culturelle (COCAC) et de la COCAC-adjointe, qui pilote le secteur science/technologie/universités, vous exercerez la coordination et participerez au pilotage stratégique, administratif et financier d’un opérateur de l'action extérieure, Campus France Brésil, afin de contribuer à la gestion et à la performance de l'organisation. Vous participerez également à la coopération universitaire, tant au niveau national qu'au niveau de la circonscription consulaire de São Paulo.

Activités principales

Les missions se déclinent comme suit :

  • Direction Campus France Brésil (75%)
  • Coordination de l’équipe dans ses missions de gestion de la procédure « études en France » et de promotion des études en France, sous l’autorité du COCAC et du COCAC adjoint. L’équipe comprend : 1 VIA, 4 ADL à São Paulo (administration, gestion, finance ; promotion et communication ; informatique et support technique ; plateforme Etudes en France et dossiers étudiants), ainsi que 5 ADL responsables d’espaces Campus France (2 à São Paulo, 3 dans les antennes de Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Recife). Les missions incluent l'élaboration du budget, la supervision des services, la coordination des activités promotionnelles, la gestion du réseau des espaces Campus France, le suivi des tableaux de bord, la participation aux événements et la création d’un réseau de partenaires brésiliens et français.
  • Actions de coopération universitaire (25%)
  • En soutien à la direction de Campus France, vous aiderez au développement de programmes de mobilité, à la co-construction de programmes de bourses, à la veille stratégique sur de nouveaux programmes de coopération, et à la diffusion d’informations sur la coopération universitaire franco-brésilienne, en coordination avec l’attachée scientifique et technique de la circonscription de São Paulo.

Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée

Master ou Doctorat, avec une connaissance approfondie du système de l’enseignement supérieur en France, notamment en relations internationales. Expérience confirmée en promotion internationale de l’enseignement supérieur et en montage de projets de coopération universitaire, en France ou à l’étranger, avec une capacité à gérer une équipe dans un environnement international.

description:
Join to apply for the Principal Architecture role at Syneos Health

Join to apply for the Principal Architecture role at Syneos Health

Description
Principal Architecture
Syneos Health is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life.
Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.
WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE
Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.
Job Responsibilities
The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for shaping and governing the overall enterprise technology architecture within Syneos Health. Operating as part of a team of Principal Architects under the Director of Enterprise Architecture, this role collaborates with peers to ensure a unified architecture strategy across the company.
The Principal Enterprise Architect focuses on technology governance, strategic alignment, architectural oversight, and systems planning and rationalization – ensuring that IT solutions and system landscapes meet business needs, adhere to standards, and are aligned with the organization’s goals. The role emphasizes maintaining a stable, secure, scalable architecture through strong governance (e.g. leading architecture review processes, driving, facilitating and enforcing cross-functional architecture standards) while providing guidance to projects. The Principal Enterprise Architect works closely with business and IT leaders and other stakeholders to align architecture to business strategy. Success in this role is measured by the consistency and efficiency of technology solutions, the effectiveness of architecture governance, the degree to which IT initiatives support the business objectives, and ability to express and rationalize systems landscapes. This position reports to the Director of Enterprise Architecture.
Core Responsibilities
  • Technology Governance & Standards: Drive robust architecture governance across IT functions, projects and systems. Drive, facilitate and enforce enterprise-wide standards, best practices, and principles for technology solutions.
    • Manage and chair the Architecture Review Board to evaluate proposed solutions for alignment with standards and the enterprise roadmap. Ensure that projects undergo proper architecture reviews and approvals, and that any exceptions are justified and documented. Track resolution to follow up items.
    • Drive stakeholder engagement and continuous improvement to architecture review processes to ensure architecture quality, maintainability, cost effectiveness, risk management, streamline approvals and improve stakeholder satisfaction / reduce friction.
    • Champion the continuous improvement of architecture practices and processes. Refine the enterprise architecture methodology, tools, and governance workflows to be more efficient and “adaptive” without compromising on quality.
  • Align Business & IT Strategy: Link the organization’s business mission and processes to its IT strategy, ensuring that current and future technology needs are met in a sustainable and adaptable manner
    • Develop and maintain architecture models and roadmaps that illustrate how the CRO’s strategic goals (e.g. efficient clinical trial operations, data-driven decision making) are supported by technology.
    • Continuously update the enterprise architecture blueprint to reflect evolving business priorities and industry practices.
  • Enterprise Architecture Development: Align the technology strategy and target architecture for assigned domain areas within the enterprise. Create future-state architecture visions and multi-year roadmaps that guide technology investments and system implementations.
  • Portfolio Rationalization: Oversee the application portfolio for the assigned domain and identify opportunities to simplify and consolidate systems. Work with IT and business stakeholders to eliminate redundant applications and drive application rationalization efforts, reducing complexity and cost. Ensure new projects do not duplicate existing functionality or introduce incompatible technologies.
  • Solution Oversight & Guidance: Provide high-level architectural oversight on complex projects.
    • Guide solution architects and project teams to ensure their designs adhere to enterprise standards, integrate well with existing systems and factor in cross-project dependencies.
    • Act as an “EA Buddy” to project teams – engaging early in projects to mentor solution architects through architecture planning and the ARB process/
  • Engage Stakeholders: Regularly meet with stakeholders to gather input, provide updates on architecture plans, and ensure that IT initiatives are meeting business and research needs. Foster strong relationships with project managers, engineers, and infrastructure teams so that architecture considerations are embedded into project lifecycles.
  • Stay informed about relevant technology trends (e.g. cloud services, artificial intelligence, data integration techniques, digital trial tools) to keep the architecture function responsive to business changes and technological advancements, with a measured and compliant approach.
Qualifications
Education Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent (required).
Additional Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, systems design, or related IT leadership roles (required). This includes a proven track record in designing and governing complex technology ecosystems and leading architecture efforts.
  • Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical research industry is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of enterprise architecture modeling tools (e.g. LeanIX), frameworks and methodologies (e.g. TOGAF) desired.
  • Experience running or contributing to an architecture review board or similar governance body is strongly preferred. The candidate should have a track record of guiding teams to follow established standards and making balanced decisions when exceptions are needed. An eye for consistency and reusability in technology solutions and meticulous attention to detail and follow through are critical.
  • Proficiency in creating architecture artifacts (principles, standards, models, roadmaps) and using architecture tools to document current and target states is expected.
  • Technical Breadth: Broad understanding of enterprise technologies and integration approaches required.
Get to know Syneos Health
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

MonetizeMore is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Job Overview
We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.
Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.)

    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement
What We're Looking For
  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tool such sa Active Campaign and header bidding solutions
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively

Pessoa Estrategista do Produto - Gerenciamento Técnico de Projetos

Local de trabalho: São Bernardo do Campo - SP

Você será responsável por gerenciar o desenvolvimento de novos projetos e/ou dos veículos em série, dentro na Engenharia do Produto SAM. Planejar/desenvolver estudos técnicos e econômicos localmente, ou em conjunto com a matriz ou coligadas. Liderar equipes multifuncionais, dando suporte à Gerência nas atividades para planejamento estratégico e implementação de projetos. Gerenciar as atividades técnicas, custos de desenvolvimento, custo de material e cronograma dos projetos. Elaborar/analisar cronogramas, documentos. Participar e apresentar status de projetos em reuniões, negociar prazos, analisar criticamente as necessidades do projeto (com plano de ação), elaborar o descritivo técnico do produto. Forte interação com as demais áreas da companhia e empresas do Grupo VW.

  • Responsável por gerenciar tecnicamente as atividades de desenvolvimento do produto para os Novos Projetos SAM;
  • Gerenciamento do time da Engenharia do Produto conforme objetivos dos projetos (escopo e cronograma) com foco em funções;
  • Criação e Gerenciamento do Technik Team de projetos;
  • Elaboração & gerenciamento do cronograma de desenvolvimento da engenharia;
  • Elaboração de status do projeto / apresentação nos respectivos fóruns;
  • Negociação de responsabilidades técnicas com demais empresas do Grupo Volkswagen;
  • Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Produção, Mecatrônica, Elétrica ou Engenharias correlatas;
  • Obrigatório Inglês Avançado/Fluente;
  • Conhecimento em gerenciamento de projetos, metodologia ágil e system engineering;
  • Desejável Pós Graduação em Gerenciamento de Projetos / Gestão de Projetos;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Alemão.

Modelo de trabalho: híbrido flexível

Benefícios:

  • Plataforma de treinamentos online gratuito;
  • Programa de Saúde e Bem-estar;
  • Ônibus fretado;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Zenklub - plataforma de saúde mental e bem-estar emocional.

Conheça a Volkswagen

A Volkswagen está na vida, no coração e na garagem dos brasileiros. São 70 anos de uma história construída por milhares de mãos, que buscam entregar produtos e serviços cada vez mais inovadores e que vão transformar os rumos da mobilidade urbana.

A Nossa Volkswagen quer ser a cada dia mais diversa, digital, ágil, centrada no cliente e neutra em carbono. O nosso compromisso é em entregar cada vez mais valor aos nossos clientes, colaboradores, parceiros e para a sociedade. Esperamos oferecer experiências incríveis e construir o futuro de uma maneira mais sustentável e surpreendente.

Incentivamos o debate, as novas ideias e soluções. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a empatia, e juntos, aceleramos!

Construa com a gente a Nossa Volkswagen !

In the role of Site Installation Engineer for Medium Gas Turbines (MGT) New Unit, you will work at a customer job site(s) you will be based in Brazil and will serve our global operations around the world. The position requires 80%+ travel to power plant sites internationally.

What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • Experience in installation of gas turbines.
  • Experience working in the field within industry with focus on mechanical and/or electrical work.
  • Strong collaborator with expertise in risk management and adaptability.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and quick to learn other software as needed.

About The Team
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Fresh off a $34M Series A funding round, we’re scaling rapidly and seeking passionate problem-solvers to join our mission.

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly motivated Junior Automation Engineer to join our growing technology team. This is a perfect opportunity for someone early in their tech career who is passionate about AI, agentic systems, and automation, and wants to be hands-on with real-world tools and workflows at the intersection of IT, security, and cutting-edge AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in automating internal workflows using AI and no-code/low-code platforms (like Make, n8n).
  • Support integration and basic maintenance tasks across tools like Google Workspace, Jira, Notion.
  • Work on building and improving agentic AI systems using tools like LangChain , CrewAI , Cursor AI.
  • Help maintain and support basic InfoSec operations , like access controls and security monitoring & incident response.
  • Collaborate with technical leads to prototype automations and AI agents for internal use cases.

Ideal Candidate

  • You are curious, proactive, and excited about the future of AI automation.
  • You may not have years of experience, but you are obsessed with learning about LLMs, AI agents, and automation.
  • You’ve experimented with tools like LangChain , OpenAI , or CrewAI — even if just for personal projects or online courses.
  • Familiarity with Firebase , Google Workspace , Jira , Notion , Make , n8n , or similar platforms is a big plus.
  • Basic understanding of IT systems , APIs , and cloud tools.
  • You have solid communication skills and can manage tasks independently in a remote environment.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, async-first, international team.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to security and compliance basics (SOC2, SSO, RBAC, Vulnerability Management, etc.).
  • Experience integrating AI agents with real-world tools.
  • Bonus: contributions to open-source AI/automation projects or side projects you can show.

  • A front-row seat to the future of AI-driven operations .
  • Freedom to experiment and grow - this is a playground for automation .
  • Work with a passionate team obsessed with scaling smart.
  • Opportunity to grow fast into a more senior technical role.
  • Generous Time Off: 27 days PTO + US holidays

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker role at Canonical

2 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: This role can be based in Americas and the assigned territory will be Chile. Being based in Chile is therefore preferable.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as Spanish for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Cargo Sapiens é uma solução SaaS (Software as a Service) focada na otimização e gestão das transações em torno de serviços de logística internacional, como frete aéreo, marítimo, terrestre e multimodal.
Ajudamos algumas das maiores empresas do mundo – dos mais diversos segmentos – a transformar seu processo de compra de fretes. Nossos Clientes alcançam altos níveis de produtividade e assertividade, economizando tempo e dinheiro, além de elevar o nível de governança e compliance.

Sobre a oportunidade :
Atuar como parceiro estratégica e consultiva das lideranças da Cargo Sapiens, com foco na construção da área de People&Culture. Essa pessoa será responsável por apoiar decisões organizacionais, estruturar processos de desenvolvimento, implementar a cultura, fortalecer a atuação da liderança e garantir uma jornada do colaborador coerente com os objetivos da empresa.

Desenvolver rituais, ações de engajamento e liderar pesquisas de clima com planos de ação efetivos. Ser agente ativo de mudança cultural e alinhamento organizacional.

THE COMPANY

We are fans who help fans everywhere access the live events they love. As a proud division of Live Nation Entertainment, Ticketmaster has changed the way the world connects with their favourite artists, teams, and shows, and we continue to shape innovation every day. We're not just selling tickets (though we do that better than anyone else!), we’re enriching lives, one amazing experience at a time. And we think that’s incredible. If you’re passionate about the magic of live entertainment like we are, and you want to work for a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want you on our team.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack .NET Developer to join our team and collaborate on the development of a financial settlement solution for the ticketing industry. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable applications, ensuring the efficiency and reliability of payment settlement processes.

This role is critical to building an innovative system that will optimize the financial flow among event organizers, customers, and payment platforms. If you’re looking for technical challenges and the opportunity to make a direct impact in a dynamic, global sector, this is the position for you!

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Develop and implement software solutions using .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) for web applications and APIs.
  • Design and maintain robust, scalable backend systems, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability in financial transaction processing.
  • Create dynamic and responsive user interfaces using modern front-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Work with SQL Server databases, including modeling, creating and maintaining complex queries, performance optimization, stored procedures, and triggers.
  • Implement unit and integration tests, ensuring code quality and system stability.
  • Apply agile development practices (Scrum, Kanban) for planning, analyzing, designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining solutions.
  • Ensure system security and compliance with regulatory standards and industry best practices for payments.
  • Collaborate with other technical and business teams to align requirements and continuously enhance the platform.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core).
  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server, including data modeling, query optimization, stored procedures, and triggers.
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js).
  • Familiarity with Git version control and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with tools like Jira or Trello.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work in a dynamic, high-impact environment.
  • Experience with payment API integrations or financial systems is a plus.
  • Knowledge of security practices and regulatory compliance in financial systems is a plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Spanish is preferred.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Initiative and Ownership: Proactively identifies opportunities for improvement and takes full ownership of projects from conception to completion.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Uses critical thinking to overcome obstacles and find innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Continuous Learning: Actively seeks to enhance skills and stay updated on industry trends, sharing knowledge with the team.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and home life. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

They will have the ability to balance and prioritize multiple projects, ask insightful questions in an ambiguous environment, and coordinate execution across various stakeholders. A proactive and hands-on approach is essential, as JumpCloud is a lean and fast-moving company.


What you’ll be doing:
  • Driving large, impactful projects involving data pipelines, database design, data modeling, and data curation for optimized analytics and business use with involvement across various stakeholders, business units, and technical partners.
  • Owning the outcomes of the analytics initiatives you’re leading. You’re not just a participant in the initiative, you hold yourself responsible for the outcome of the project.
  • Gathering requirements and providing actionable recommendations to technical stakeholders, driving adoption and execution of recommendations.
  • Mentoring and growing the other analysts and engineers across the organization. We’ve got a great organization full of a lot of potential, you’ll be helping the other members of the organization achieve their potential.
  • Supporting team's project management, strategic decision-making, and long-term planning.
  • Staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data engineering, database design, data modeling, and data governance and applying them to support our business needs.
We’re looking for:
  • Advanced knowledge and experience in SQL and relational databases; Snowflake experience highly preferred.
  • Advanced knowledge in database design, data modeling, data infrastructure, data pipelines, and ELT process to support analytics and business operations. DBT, Airflow, Fivetran, AWS, and GitHub experiences are highly preferred.
  • Advanced understanding of coding and markup languages and can create complex queries from multiple data sources, views, and tables and have an understanding of our company's data architecture and how to apply it.
  • Advanced understanding and experience with scripting languages such as Python (numpy, pandas).
  • Intermediate analytical skills and a passion for data storytelling and quantitative analysis.
  • Understanding in one or more business Intelligence / data visualization tools; Tableau experience highly preferred.
  • Strong mentoring skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and desire to learn.
  • Effective stakeholder management skills and communication skills.
  • Effective project management and organizational skills; Agile experience is a plus.
  • Experience with Data Governance best practices.
  • Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, unstructured, dynamic environment.
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems, or another quantitative field.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps.
Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. They are also central to the health of critical infrastructure across the globe. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users.
While Ubuntu has been enormously successful and in many senses leads the industry, we think we can substantially improve our practices, quality and performance in the web services domain. We are growing our teams, and in doing so we aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices.

Marketing at TRACTIAN:

This includes managing our editorial calendar, optimizing performance across channels, and aligning with business goals.   • Experience with SEO tools (e.g., Semrush, Ahrefs) and CMS platforms.
  • Data-driven mindset with experience measuring content impact on traffic, leads, and pipeline.
  • Highly autonomous, organized, and deadline-oriented.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/month extra for activities.

Responsável pela execução, controle e execução da manutenção preventiva e corretiva nos equipamentos industriais, visando mantê-los disponíveis e seguros, dentro de programação de manutenção existente.
Responsabilidades do Cargo

title: PESSOA EXECUTIVA VENDAS - PESADOS - FLORIANOPOLIS/SC
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa que valoriza a integridade, a simplicidade e a inovação contínua, construindo juntos um futuro melhor.

Na Embracon, temos como propósito: realizar sonhos e oferecer oportunidades para você mostrar todo o seu talento e crescer profissionalmente.

Queremos pessoas inovadoras e comprometidas para se juntar ao nosso time! Aqui, você pode construir sua carreira, desenvolver-se e trazer novas ideias. Valorizamos um ambiente amigável, incentivamos a troca de experiências e respeitamos as diferenças.

Na Embracon trabalhamos diariamente para sermos diversos e inclusivos, independentemente de raça, etnia, idade, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência. Somos conscientes das desigualdades do nosso país, por isso entendemos, desenvolvemos e fortalecemos a diversidade para tomada de decisões mais assertivas e abrangentes, que permitem alavancar nossos negócios e nos aproximar de clientes e da sociedade.

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que preza pela realização de sonhos e que se dedica a promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado. Aqui, cada voz importa e, em união, realizamos sonhos!


Main responsibilities

Como será o dia a dia:

1. Prospecção e Atendimento ao Cliente

Prospecção de Clientes: Identifica e contata potenciais clientes interessados na aquisição de caminhões e ônibus através de consórcio.

Atendimento Personalizado: Oferece consultoria personalizada para entender as necessidades e perfil financeiro dos clientes, explicando como o consórcio pode ser uma solução vantajosa para a compra de veículos.

2. Apresentação e Explicação de Produtos

Explicação do Consórcio: Detalha os diferentes planos de consórcio disponíveis, incluindo condições de pagamento, prazos, taxas e regras de contemplação.

Integração com a Venda de Veículos: Coordena com os vendedores de showroom para apresentar como o consórcio se integra com a aquisição dos caminhões e ônibus, oferecendo uma solução completa para o cliente.

3. Negociação e Fechamento de Vendas

Negociação de Condições: Negocia as condições do consórcio, ajustando-as conforme as necessidades e capacidade financeira do cliente.

Fechamento de Contratos: Finaliza o contrato do consórcio, assegurando que todos os documentos e requisitos administrativos sejam cumpridos.

4. Acompanhamento do Processo de Compra

Monitoramento do Consórcio: Acompanha o andamento do consórcio desde a assinatura até a contemplação, mantendo o cliente informado sobre o progresso.

Coordenação com o Vendedor de Showroom: Trabalha em conjunto com o vendedor de showroom para garantir que a entrega do caminhão ou ônibus esteja alinhada com o processo do consórcio.

5. Suporte Pós-Venda

Assistência ao Cliente: Oferece suporte contínuo após a venda, resolvendo quaisquer dúvidas ou problemas relacionados ao consórcio e ao financiamento.

Gerenciamento de Contemplações: Auxilia o cliente em caso de contemplação e na efetivação da aquisição do veículo.

6. Monitoramento de Mercado e Concorrência

Análise de Mercado: Avalia as tendências do mercado de consórcios e as ofertas da concorrência para ajustar estratégias e melhorar as propostas.

Atualização de Conhecimento: Mantém-se atualizado sobre as mudanças nas condições do mercado e nas regulamentações de consórcio.

7. Planejamento e Estratégia de Vendas

Desenvolvimento de Estratégias: Cria e implementa estratégias para promover os consórcios e aumentar as vendas dentro da concessionária.

Colaboração com a Equipe de Vendas: Trabalha em sinergia com a equipe de vendas de veículos para otimizar a abordagem de vendas e atingir as metas estabelecidas.

8. Gestão da Documentação e Processos Administrativos

Documentação de Consórcio: Garante que toda a documentação relacionada ao consórcio esteja correta e completa, facilitando o processo administrativo.

Processos Administrativos: Coordena com as áreas administrativas para garantir a conformidade com os requisitos e a execução eficiente dos processos.

title: Customer Success Senior Analyst
description:
Aboute the role:

We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Analyst to manage Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts, ensuring the best experience and results for our strategic clients. You will be the main point of contact, acting as a business partner focused on onboarding, engagement, expansion, and retention.

Responsibilities:

  • Onboarding and Training: Lead the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring efficient implementation and comprehensive training for client teams.
  • Understanding Client Objectives: Map and understand clients’ business goals, aligning expectations and proposing Sinch solutions tailored to each account’s context.
  • Relationship and Expansion: Build strong relationships with clients, promoting engagement, satisfaction, and identifying cross-sell/up-sell opportunities.
  • Success Planning: Develop, execute, and monitor personalized success plans with clear goals and performance indicators (KPIs).
  • KPI Monitoring: Track and analyze usage, engagement, message volume, generated revenue, NPS, churn, and other key metrics, generating insights and recommendations.
  • QBRs and EBRs: Prepare and present Quarterly/Executive Business Reviews, highlighting achievements, opportunities, and next steps.
  • Success Stories: Create and share success cases and best practices, both for clients and internal use.
  • Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with internal teams (sales, product, support, marketing, finance) to resolve client requests and ensure high-value deliveries.
  • Portfolio Prioritization: Manage a portfolio of clients, prioritizing actions according to potential, risk, and expansion opportunities.
  • Internal Presentations: Provide visibility on client status, achievements, and challenges to different areas of the company, influencing strategic decisions.
  • Data Analysis: Use data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker) to extract, analyze, and present insights on client usage.
  • CRM Management: Use Salesforce (or similar) to record, track, and consult activities, interactions, and opportunities.
  • Ownership and Urgency: Act as the client’s advocate within Sinch, with a sense of urgency, ownership, and total focus on client satisfaction and success.

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related areas, preferably in technology, SaaS, Telecom, or CPaaS companies.
  • Experience with Mid-Market and/or Enterprise clients.
  • Proven skills in project management, organization, and prioritization.
  • Experience conducting QBRs/EBRs and executive presentations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
  • Familiarity with CRMs, especially Salesforce.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage different stakeholders.
  • Collaborative, proactive, resilient, and results-oriented profile.
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and focus on delivering excellent customer service.

Nice to have:

  • Advanced English.
  • Certifications in Customer Success (e.g., SuccessHACKER, CS Institute) or project management (PMP, Scrum)

  • Conhecimento de legislação e regulamentos aplicáveis a compras públicas ou processos similares (ex.: Lei nº 14.133/2021 ou regulamentos do Sistema S);
  • Habilidades avançadas em excel;

Em 2020, a Volkswagen do Brasil aderiu aos Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres (Womens’s Empowerment Principles - WEPs, na sigla em inglês), iniciativa criada pela ONU Mulheres e o Pacto Global das Nações Unidas. Dessa forma, a VW se une a mais de 300 empresas signatárias no Brasil.

Em 2022, a Volkswagen anunciou a emissão de títulos de dívida de 500 milhões de reais, atrelados a compromissos claros da montadora de aumentar a participação de mulheres na liderança e a redução nas emissões de CO2 de origem fóssil em suas fábricas.

Com essas medidas, a VW firma ainda mais o seu compromisso em promover a igualdade de gênero na companhia, e em neutralizar emissões de carbono.
